articles.title_en: The Hedging Channel of Exchange Rate Determination
articles.title_cn: 汇率决定的套期保值渠道
articles.abstract_en: We propose the currency hedging channel that connects countries’ external imbalances to their exchange rate behavior. We present a model in which investors increase their currency hedging during periods of financial distress in proportion to their net foreign asset exposure. This behavior coupled with constrained financial intermediation explains observed relationships between gradually adjusting external imbalances and volatile spot and forward exchange rates. We find empirical support for the hedging channel in both the conditional and unconditional moments of exchange rates, option prices, and countries’ uses of Federal Reserve swap lines.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了货币套期保值渠道，该渠道将国家的外部失衡与其汇率行为联系起来。我们提出了一个模型，在该模型中，投资者在金融困境期间根据其净外国资产敞口按比例增加货币套期保值。这种行为加上受限的金融中介，解释了逐渐调整的外部失衡与波动的即期和远期汇率之间观察到的关系。我们在汇率的条件和非条件矩、期权价格以及各国对美联储互换额度的使用中，找到了套期保值渠道的实证支持。

articles.title_en: Real Consequences of Shocks to Intermediaries Supplying Corporate Hedging Instruments
articles.title_cn: 企业套期保值工具供应中介冲击的实际后果
articles.abstract_en: I show that shocks to financial intermediaries supplying hedging instruments to corporations have real effects. I exploit a quasi-natural experiment in South Korea in 2010, where regulations required banks to hold enough capital for taking foreign exchange derivatives (FXD) positions. Using variation in exposure to this regulation across banks, I find that the regulation caused a reduction in FXD supply, leading to a significant decline in exports for firms contracting derivatives with more exposed banks. Results indicate the crucial role of intermediaries in allocating risks through derivatives provision and establish a causal relationship between financial hedging and real economic outcomes.
articles.abstract_cn: 我展示了向企业提供套期保值工具的金融中介所受到的冲击具有实际效应。我利用了韩国在2010年的一项准自然实验，当时法规要求银行在持有外汇衍生品头寸时保持足够的资本。利用不同银行对该法规暴露程度的差异，我发现该法规导致了外汇衍生品供应的减少，进而使得与暴露程度较高的银行签订衍生品合约的企业出口显著下降。结果表明，中介在通过衍生品供应分配风险中扮演关键角色，并确立了金融套期保值与实际经济结果之间的因果关系。

articles.title_en: Long-Term Investors, Demand Shifts, and Yields
articles.title_cn: 长期投资者、需求变动与收益率
articles.abstract_en: I exploit a Dutch reform in the regulatory discount curve that makes the liabilities of pension funds and insurance companies (P&Is) more sensitive to changes in 20-year interest rates but less so to longer maturity rates. Following the reform, P&Is reduced their longest maturity bond holdings but increased those with 20-year maturities, steepening the long end of the yield curve. Using the reform as a shock to identify price elasticities of demand at the sector level based on holdings across maturity buckets and time, I show that banks are more price elastic than other investors and absorb demand shocks.
articles.abstract_cn: 我利用荷兰监管贴现曲线的改革，该改革使得养老金和保险公司的负债对20年期利率的变化更为敏感，而对更长期限利率的敏感度降低。改革后，养老金和保险公司减少了最长期限的债券持有，但增加了20年期债券的持有，从而陡化了收益率曲线的长端。利用该改革作为冲击，基于不同期限区间和时间的持有量来识别部门层面的需求价格弹性，我表明银行比其他投资者更具价格弹性，并吸收了需求冲击。

articles.title_cn: 基于久期的公司债券估值
articles.abstract_en: We decompose corporate bond and equity index returns into duration-matched government bond returns and the excess returns over this duration-matched counterfactual, which we term duration-adjusted returns. Compared with previously used excess return definitions (ie, returns in excess of Treasury bills), our decomposition leads to markedly different return patterns and asset pricing implications. In particular, we find that investment-grade bonds earn a small credit risk premium, comparable in magnitude to the convenience yield, and that duration adjustment resolves the CAPM’s failure to price corporate bonds. These findings highlight the importance of adjusting for nonstationary interest rate environments in asset pricing tests.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们将公司债券和股票指数回报分解为久期匹配的政府债券回报以及相对于这一久期匹配反事实的超额回报，我们称之为久期调整回报。与先前使用的超额回报定义（即相对于国库券的回报）相比，我们的分解导致了显著不同的回报模式和资产定价含义。特别是，我们发现投资级债券赚取较小的信用风险溢价，其规模与便利收益相当，并且久期调整解决了CAPM无法对公司债券定价的问题。这些发现强调了在资产定价测试中调整非平稳利率环境的重要性。

articles.title_en: Capital Investment, Equity Returns, and Aggregate Dynamics in Oligopolistic Production Economies
articles.title_cn: 寡头垄断生产经济体中的资本投资、股票收益与总体动态
articles.abstract_en: We analyze effects of tacit collusion in a dynamic general equilibrium model of oligopolistic sectors with capital investment and real frictions. Through their effects on equilibrium- and off-equilibrium stock prices, fundamental shocks affect incentives for defection from tacit collusion, amplifying the interaction between the real economy and financial markets as well as firms’ risk exposure. The model implies ambiguous relationship between industry concentration and equity returns depending on operating leverage, which helps reconcile conflicting evidence in the literature. We find quantitative and empirical support for novel theoretical predictions regarding the effects of concentration on returns and investment.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在一个具有资本投资和实际摩擦的寡头垄断部门动态一般均衡模型中分析了默契合谋的影响。通过其对均衡和非均衡股票价格的影响，基本面冲击影响了对默契合谋背叛的激励，放大了实体经济与金融市场之间的相互作用以及企业的风险暴露。该模型暗示行业集中度与股票收益之间的关系取决于经营杠杆，这有助于调和文献中的矛盾证据。我们为关于集中度对收益和投资影响的新颖理论预测找到了数量和经验上的支持。

articles.title_en: Dynamic Market Making with Asymmetric Information and Market Power
articles.title_cn: 不对称信息与市场力量下的动态做市
articles.abstract_en: We study the dynamics of trading volume and bid-ask spread using a multiperiod trading model with oligopolistic market makers. Traders smooth out their trading even though they are not strategic, and thus trading persists after the arrival of information or liquidity shocks. Traders act quickly on their private information while postponing hedging trades until later periods. The market power of market makers enables them to widen bid-ask spreads when trading incentives are heightened. Consequently, both trading volume and bid-ask spread may exhibit U-shaped patterns. Our model calibration aligns with the empirical intraday patterns observed in bid-ask spreads and trading volumes. (JEL D53, D61, D82, G12, G14, G18)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过一个具有寡头做市商的多期交易模型研究交易量和买卖价差的动态变化。交易者即使不是策略性的，也会平滑其交易，因此交易在信息或流动性冲击到达后持续存在。交易者迅速利用其私人信息行动，而将对冲交易推迟到后期。做市商的市场力量使他们能够在交易激励增强时扩大买卖价差。因此，交易量和买卖价差都可能呈现U型模式。我们的模型校准与观察到的买卖价差和交易量的日内经验模式一致。(JEL D53, D61, D82, G12, G14, G18)

articles.abstract_en: We highlight the limitations of using cumulative advertising expenses as an input measure of brand value. Using two output measures—Interbrand’s data and a novel text-based measure—we find that an equal-weighted portfolio of top brands yields an annual abnormal return of 3%. The excess returns are driven by companies that develop their brands internally. Intangible factors proposed in the literature have no explanatory power for the premium. Analysts underestimate the future earnings of top brands, leading to significant excess returns following earnings announcements. We find no abnormal returns associated with the input measure of brand value. (JEL G4, G12, G14, M41)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们强调了使用累计广告费用作为品牌价值投入指标的局限性。采用两种产出指标——Interbrand的数据和一种新颖的基于文本的度量——我们发现，顶级品牌等权重投资组合的年化异常回报率为3%。超额回报由内部开发品牌的公司驱动。文献中提出的无形因素对溢价没有解释力。分析师低估了顶级品牌的未来收益，导致盈利公告后出现显著的超额回报。我们发现与品牌价值投入指标相关的异常回报不存在。(JEL G4, G12, G14, M41)
